neighbours.label: The character 駐 at the start of 駐車場 (parking lot) inside a full Japanese or Chinese sentence saying a hotel, inn, hospital or similar place has a parking lot. 駐 in other words (駐在 'stationed', 駐留, 駐車 as the verb 'to park', as in 'no parking'), other places' facilities without 駐車場, other first characters of two-character words, and a bare one-line list item '無料駐車場' stay low. Known weaker leak: 吉 in 唐吉訶德 (Don Quixote).
